title: chamaemelum caucasicum
intro: Chamaemelum caucasicum, commonly known as Caucasian chamomile, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. It is often used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and promoting relaxation, improving sleep quality, and soothing digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Chamaemelum caucasicum are attributed to its calming effects on the nervous system, making it an effective treatment for insomnia and restlessness. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including apigenin and luteolin, are responsible for its medicinal properties, which also exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities.
